name: Login rejection with invalid credentials and doctor sign in
description: Verify invalid credentials show clear error message, and doctor quick demo login succeeds and enters the clinician dashboard.

planSteps.description: Type 'invalid@hospital.gov' into the Institutional Email field
Verify an error message indicating invalid credentials or authentication failure appears
Click the Doctor quick demo account card to pre-fill valid credentials
Verify the user is redirected to /dashboard and the clinical shift dashboard appears with shift metrics
